stage: built and rendered at 1440 and 390 px

choice-justified:directed-handoff-flow.why: The question is which lane a change takes and where it is checked; a handoff flow puts each lane and each refusing check on the page as nodes and edges. Router listed it as an alternative.

rejected:project-schedule.why: Router's top pick, but the plan has no dates; order of work units is in the plan text, and a schedule would hide the lanes.

rejected:process-swimlane.why: Lanes here are routes a change can take, not actors; swimlanes by actor would split the single commit hook across rows.

accessibility: state by outline (exists: solid blue fill; planned: dashed; refusing check: heavy black; escape case: orange), plus words on every node; no red/green
mobile: under 760 px the graph becomes nine numbered cards; 390 px render 390 wide, no horizontal scroll
